name: @potyro/sync-gate
author: Edgar Zanella Alvarenga
description: The gate in front of the sync relay (docs/16 "The gate in front of the relay"): a websocket proxy that holds each address to a number of connections, a rate of connections, a rate of bytes and frames (by slowing it, not closing it) and a number of bytes a day, holds the whole relay to bytes a day and a floor of free disk, and has the place where a plan token will be checked. It never reads what it forwards. No dependencies; depends on no Potyro package.
